items.briefing:
Australian education platform Mathspace has suffered a significant data breach affecting over one million students, parents, and teachers. Personal information was exposed, making this highly relevant to any registered training organisation that uses or recommends similar ed-tech platforms. Staff should check whether their organisation or any learners use Mathspace and watch for follow-up phishing attempts targeting those affected.

Separately, AI-powered scams are becoming increasingly convincing and harder to detect. Cybercriminals are using AI to craft realistic messages that manipulate people into acting quickly. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected message asking for personal details or urgent action — even if it sounds legitimate — verify it through a separate, known contact method before responding.

featured.title: Mathspace breach exposed data of more than 1 million students, parents and teachers
